full_prompt_en: A square dark-fantasy digital painting shows an armored figure from the chest up inside a chamber of elaborate carved stone. The figure faces to the right in three-quarter profile, wearing a metallic helmet with a long projecting respirator muzzle, circular side mechanisms, and tall swept-back fins. Only a narrow strip of skin is visible near one eye; the rest of the face disappears behind layered silver-gray plates and ribbed breathing parts. The shoulders and chest are covered with dense overlapping armor, decorated by engraved lines, cables, gears, and round fittings. A thick dark hose runs down from the jaw toward the lower chest, reinforcing the heavy mechanical silhouette. Behind the figure, an arched stone niche rises with concentric scrolls, small columns, and tightly carved relief patterns. The background is nearly as detailed as the suit, but its warmer brown-gray tone keeps the cooler armor foremost. A narrow light from the upper left grazes the helmet crest, visor rim, and raised plates, leaving deep black pockets inside the mouthpiece and between the carved blocks. Surface wear appears as scratches, tarnish, and dusty deposits rather than smooth clean chrome. The composition is closely cropped, with little open sky or floor; the figure and chamber press against the frame edges. The eye follows repeated circular fittings from helmet to chest and then into the stone motifs behind. No readable inscription appears among the decoration. The overall composition is oppressive and ceremonial, using densely worked metal and stone to turn the armored profile into a monumental, timeworn relic.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑暗幻想数字绘画描绘一位胸部以上的装甲人物置于繁复雕刻石室中。人物以三分之二侧面朝右，戴金属头盔，前方伸出长呼吸面罩，侧边有圆机械件，顶部有向后掠的高鳍片。一只眼附近仅露一条狭窄皮肤，其余脸消失在层叠银灰甲片与肋纹呼吸构件后。肩胸被密集重叠装甲覆盖，上面有刻线、线缆、齿轮和圆配件。一根粗深管从下颌延至胸下，强化沉重机械剪影。人物背后，拱形石龛带同心卷纹、小柱和密刻浮雕图案升起。背景几乎和甲胄一样细密，但更暖的棕灰色让冷甲片处于前景。狭窄光从左上擦过头盔脊、面罩边和凸起甲片，口部内侧与雕石之间留深黑空隙。表面磨损是划痕、失去光泽和尘垢，而非平滑干净镀铬。构图紧密裁切，几乎没有开放天空或地面；人物和石室挤到画边。视线沿重复圆配件从头盔到胸甲，再进入后方石纹。装饰里没有可读铭文。整体构图压迫而有仪式感，以密集金属与石材把装甲侧影变成宏大、磨旧的遗物。
style_prompt_en: The image has dense dark-fantasy digital painting with interlocking hard surfaces and ornate relief texture. Tarnished silver, stone brown, charcoal, and dull bronze form a narrow aged palette. Circular fittings, ribs, cables, and engraved scrolls repeat at different scales, creating a close-packed rhythm without flattening the volume. Grazing light picks out protruding edges and leaves cavities nearly black, so material depth remains strong despite the crowded detail. Scratches, dust, and worn metal soften any new-machine shine. The overall effect is monumental, claustrophobic, and ceremonial.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有密集黑暗幻想数字绘画性，以互锁硬表面和繁复浮雕肌理为主。失光银色、石棕、炭灰与暗青铜组成狭窄陈旧配色。圆配件、肋纹、线缆与雕刻卷纹以不同尺度重复，形成紧密节奏，却没有压平体积。擦过表面的光选出凸边，凹处近乎黑色，因此即使细节拥挤，材料纵深仍强。划痕、灰尘和磨旧金属软化新机器的亮泽。整体效果宏大、幽闭且带仪式感。
theme_en: An armored figure in an ornate respirator helmet before carved stone
theme_zh: 戴繁复呼吸面罩头盔的装甲人物立于雕刻石壁前
name: J.P. Targete
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
